title: A/R Collection: the Location chip hides when only one location has data
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • On {Date-A} the organization's open A/R documents were all at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Date-A} is a date before {Location-B}'s first invoice.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for the Location chip.
  2. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Change the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  4. Look for the Location chip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Location chip shows (two locations in the list).
  • Step 2: the chip still shows, reading {Location-A}'s name, so the choice can be undone.
  • Step 3: the report reloads for {Date-A}.
  • Step 4: the Location chip is not shown: the only location in the list is ticked.

If step 3 keeps {Location-B} unticked in the address, tick every location before step 3; the case is about the one-location list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R9: “The chip is shown whenever the report's list (S5-R3) has two or more locations, and always while fewer than all are ticked, so the choice can always be undone.”
  • S5-N1: “If the organization's open documents sit at only one location and it is ticked, the Location chip is not shown.”
